data.name: 72 Seconds
data.detailed_description:
72 Seconds is a fast-paced, high-stakes isometric RTS that blends retro micro-heavy combat with modern ARPG progression and base building.

Command elite squads on hostile sci-fi battlefields where victory depends on rapid positioning, smart tech expansion, and tactical unit micro. Every campaign tests your adaptability as enemy forces spawn with unpredictable stat affixes and aggressive tactics.

KEY FEATURES

• Fast-Paced Action RTS Combat Master precision micro and tactical positioning. Control specialized squads in intense real-time engagements against relentless alien forces.

• ARPG Squad Progression & Skill Trees Level up your units across runs, unlocking specialized tech and passive skill tree paths to tailor your army to your playstyle.

• Base Building & Resource Management Establish forward operating bases, extract vital resources, and unlock advanced tech tiers to bolster your defensive perimeters and production capacity.

• Dynamic Enemy Affixes No two runs play out the same. Hostile units spawn with randomized modifiers, boosting their speed, health pools, or lethal attack abilities, forcing you to constantly adapt your tactical strategy.

• High-Stakes Permadeath Unit preservation is paramount. While downed units can be recovered with specialized tech, a total squad wipe resets your campaign back to square one.

• Built-In Map Editor Design, construct, and test your own custom maps and combat scenarios with the included level editor.

data.short_description: 72 Seconds is a fast-paced isometric action RTS where tactical squad micro meets ARPG progression. Command specialized units, build defenses, upgrade skill trees, and battle hostile alien threats. Adapt to randomized enemy affixes and survive high-stakes campaign permadeath.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 / DirectX 11 compatible integrated graphics (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) or Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal / OpenGL 3.3 compatible graphics (Intel HD 4000, Apple M1, or better)
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Arch Linux, or SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible graphics card / Mesa drivers
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
